items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You said his name was Bluch or something on that other record.

ctx.x: trombone, you, Gary McFarland on vibes and vocal, George Ricci, cello, Sam Brown, guitar, Ron Carter and Chet Amsterdam, and then Grady Tate and Sol Gubin, and then Airto.
Did you remember you mentioned Sam Brown earlier? You said his name was Bluch or something on that other record.
